quizzes.title: General Knowledge Quiz
quizzes.description: Test your knowledge across various topics

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for water?
questions.explanation: Water is composed of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom, hence H2O.

questions.question: The Earth is flat.
questions.explanation: The Earth is an oblate spheroid (nearly spherical), not flat.

questions.question: In which year did World War II end?
questions.explanation: World War II ended in 1945 with the surrender of Germany in May and Japan in September.

questions.question: What planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars is called the Red Planet because of its reddish appearance due to iron oxide on its surface.
questions.hint: It's the fourth planet from the Sun

questions.question: Which of the following are noble gases?
questions.explanation: Noble gases are the elements in Group 18 of the periodic table. They include Helium, Neon, Argon, Krypton, Xenon, and Radon.

questions.question: Who wrote 'Romeo and Juliet'?
questions.explanation: Romeo and Juliet is a tragedy written by William Shakespeare early in his career about two young star-crossed lovers.
questions.hint: A famous English playwright from the 16th century

questions.question: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language.
questions.explanation: HTML indeed stands for HyperText Markup Language, the standard language for creating web pages.

questions.question: How many players are on a soccer team on the field at one time?
questions.explanation: A soccer (football) team has 11 players on the field at one time, including the goalkeeper.

questions.question: What is the capital of France?
questions.explanation: Paris is the capital and most populous city of France.

quizzes.title: Programming Basics
quizzes.description: Test your knowledge of programming fundamentals

questions.question: What does HTML stand for?
questions.explanation: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language, used to structure web pages.

questions.question: JavaScript and Java are the same programming language.
questions.explanation: JavaScript and Java are completely different languages with different purposes and syntax.

questions.question: Which of the following are programming paradigms?
questions.explanation: Object-Oriented, Functional, Procedural, and Declarative are all valid programming paradigms. Sequential is not a recognized paradigm.

questions.question: What keyword is used to declare a variable in JavaScript that cannot be reassigned?
questions.explanation: The 'const' keyword is used to declare variables that cannot be reassigned in JavaScript.

questions.question: What is the time complexity of binary search?
questions.explanation: Binary search has a time complexity of O(log n) because it divides the search space in half with each iteration.
questions.hint: It involves repeatedly dividing the search space
